witnesses.separates: $NearestBody from the concept: one field cell lies between the head and the body. The concept finds no body cell next to the head and is undefined; $NearestBody casts from the head away from the nearest body cell.
$FirstNonfield from the concept: a frame-colored cell lies inside the field on the ray. The concept paints the first cell outside the field rectangle; $FirstNonfield paints the speck.
$StoredPaint from the concept: the stored paint color is reassigned to 3. The concept paints the exit cell with the field color; $StoredPaint paints it 3.

$DerivedField from the concept: the field is color 3 in place of 7. The stored field color finds no field and the concept is undefined; $DerivedField reads the field as 3 and paints the exit cell 3; $FirstNonfield paints the cell after the head 7.

$DerivedPointer from the concept: the body is color 2 and the head is color 6. The concept finds head-colored cells with no adjacent body cell and is undefined; $DerivedPointer reads the single 6 as the head and casts down; $NearestBody casts up from every 2.
$BodyAxis from the concept: the head sits diagonally past the end of a vertical body. The concept casts diagonally away from the body cell it touches; $BodyAxis casts down along the body's axis.
$ScanHead from the concept: a second pointer points up from (8,4). The concept extends both pointers; $ScanHead, at the stored head orders, gives two grids, each extending one of the two heads alone.

$ScanHead from $EveryHead: a frame cell at (5,12) takes the head color. $ScanHead, at the order from the bottom-right corner with rows first, casts from the head in the field alone; $EveryHead also casts from (5,12), or is undefined where that cell has no step.

$FirstNonfield from the concept where the pointer colors are derived: a body-colored cell lies in the field on the ray at (10,9). The concept paints the first cell outside the field rectangle; $FirstNonfield paints the body-colored cell.

$DerivedField from field_color=DominantColor, and paint_color=DominantColor & StoredPaint from the concept: the field is rows 1-7, the frame color 5 is the commonest color, and the exit cell (8,9) is 8. $DerivedField reads the field as 7 and paints (8,9) 7, as the concept does; field_color=DominantColor reads the field as 5 and paints nothing; paint_color=DominantColor & StoredPaint paints (8,9) 5.

$Adjacent from $NearestBody: the head at (6,10) touches the body cell (5,9) diagonally, and a stray body cell at (8,10) lies at the same taxicab distance. $Adjacent casts down-right from the one touching body cell and paints (8,12); $NearestBody finds two nearest body cells whose steps differ, and the open tie orders disagree, so it is undefined.

$EveryHead from $ScanHead where the pointer colors are derived: a second pointer stands in the frame, head (8,0) and body (9,0). The field's box holds one head cell, so the derived pointer is found. $EveryHead casts from both heads and also paints (7,0); $ScanHead finds that the open head orders pick different heads, and is undefined.

$StoredField from $DerivedField: the pointer runs along the field's top row, with the head at the field's corner (1,2), and the frame cells next to it are 9. The stored field 7 paints (1,1); the cells next to the pointer are mostly 9, so $DerivedField reads the field as 9, whose box holds the ray to the grid edge, and changes nothing; with derived pointer colors, $DerivedField finds no field color and is undefined, while field_color=DominantColor reads 7 and paints (1,1).

$FirstNonfield from the concept: a pointer in the frame, body (9,0) and head (10,1), casts down-right onto the head (11,2) of a pointer in the field, whose body is (12,3). The concept paints (10,1) and (13,4); $FirstNonfield stops at (11,2) and paints (10,1) and (11,2).
`field_color=DominantColor` from the stored value: train 0 with 7 and 0 swapped
`head_color=RarestColor` from the stored value: train 0 with 2 and 0 swapped
`paint_color=DominantColor` from the stored value: train 0 with 7 and 0 swapped

the stored head color from head_color=RarestColor: two-heads with a frame cell at (0,13) of color 3. The stored head color gives the two-heads outputs, and every head_color=RarestColor copy takes 3 as the head color, whose one cell has no body cell next to it, and is undefined.

the stored head color from head_color=RarestColor under $BodyAxis and $ScanHead: stray-head with a frame cell at (0,13) of color 3. The stored head color casts from the head in the field and paints (13,9). Every head_color=RarestColor copy takes 3 as the head color; under $BodyAxis its one cell steps up off the grid and paints nothing.

$FirstNonfield from $FieldExit under $BodyAxis and $ScanHead with derived pointer colors: the frame-head input, at the order from the top-left corner with rows first. $ScanHead picks the frame head at (10,1), which casts down-right onto the head in the field at (11,2). $FieldExit passes over that head and paints (13,4); $FirstNonfield stops at it and paints (11,2).
